# MODAX

> MODAX is a hosted, modular CRM with an AI copilot built in. A business licenses only the modules it needs (contacts and deals, invoicing, quotes, service desk, campaigns, kiosk) and runs them in the browser or on a branded kiosk, with nothing to install. It works in English and Arabic. Made by Khatib Designs Ltd (Sofia, Bulgaria).

The app runs at https://app.modax.app. Start free at https://app.modax.app/signup, or try a live demo at https://app.modax.app/try.

## Plans
- Starter: free. Contacts, deals and invoices; 1 workspace; web app and kiosk; community support.
- Growth: $19 per user per month. Everything in Starter plus quotes, service desk, campaigns, automations, a shared inbox, the AI copilot and marketplace add-ons.
- Scale: custom pricing. White-label and custom domains, publisher marketplace with revenue share, SSO and priority support.

## Related
- Modax Flow (https://modaxflow.com): the WhatsApp and website assistant from the same team, done for you, for GCC clinics, real estate, restaurants, schools and stores.
